questions.q:
Simplify to a single trigonometric ratio:
[sin(180° − x) · cos(x − 360°) · tan(−x)] / [cos(90° + x) · cos(180° + x)]
questions.qAf:
Vereenvoudig tot ’n enkele trigonometriese verhouding:
[sin(180° − x) · cos(x − 360°) · tan(−x)] / [cos(90° + x) · cos(180° + x)]
points: = −sin x cos x tan x / (sin x cos x) = −tan x
pointsAf: = −sin x cos x tan x / (sin x cos x) = −tan x

sections.title: Trigonometry in 2D and 3D

questions.q: Show that QR = m · sin β / sin(α + β).
questions.qAf: Toon dat QR = m · sin β / sin(α + β).
points: QR / sin β = m / sin∠RQS (sine rule)
sin(180° − (α + β)) = sin(α + β), so QR = m · sin β / sin(α + β)
pointsAf: sin(180° − (α + β)) = sin(α + β), dus QR = m · sin β / sin(α + β)

questions.q: Hence show that h = m · sin β · tan θ / sin(α + β).
questions.qAf: Toon vervolgens dat h = m · sin β · tan θ / sin(α + β).
points: h = QR · tan θ = m · sin β · tan θ / sin(α + β)
pointsAf: h = QR · tan θ = m · sin β · tan θ / sin(α + β)

questions.q: Calculate h if m = 75 m, α = 55°, β = 62° and θ = 30°.

questions.q: Calculate the area of △QRS for these values.
questions.qAf: Bereken die oppervlakte van △QRS vir hierdie waardes.
points: area = ½ · RS · QR · sin α = ½(75)(74,32) sin 55°
pointsAf: oppervlakte = ½ · RS · QR · sin α = ½(75)(74,32) sin 55°
